_provenance: OURS, NOT THE SPECIFICATION'S. No AG-UI adapter exists yet, so no conforming provider-shaped stream exists to capture. The AG-UI event shapes here were written by us. What is NOT ours is the material inside them: every id and the summary text were observed on the wire from the Responses WebSocket API on 2026-08-22, in the probe recorded in docs/agui.md. Carries no upstream licence -- nothing here is copied from the AG-UI repository.
_why_here: See README.md. The spec-derived files test whether we read the specification right. This one tests whether a real provider stream fits inside what the specification allows. They fail differently and neither substitutes for the other.

cases.name: run_started_with_a_real_response_id
cases.note: Observed. A provider run id is not a UUID and not hyphenated -- it is `resp_` plus 48 hex characters. ag-ui-core 0.1.0 rejects this, and rejects the spec's own `run-5678` too, so this is not the only payload that catches that defect. It is the one that catches a LENGTH assumption, which no spec fixture here does.

cases.name: reasoning_message_carrying_a_real_summary_delta
cases.note: Observed verbatim, first delta of a reasoning summary. Three things at once: markdown emphasis the renderer will interpret, a REAL NEWLINE inside the delta, and a multi-token delta rather than a single word. The newline is the case kobold-proto/src/codec.rs rests on -- it must survive as an escape and keep the message on one line.

cases.name: reasoning_message_with_a_non_ascii_delta
cases.note: Observed. A curly apostrophe (U+2019) inside reasoning text. Not exotic -- the model produced it unprompted on a two-sentence arithmetic summary, so it is the common case rather than the edge one.

cases.name: reasoning_bracketed_by_start_and_end
cases.note: Shapes are ours; the id is observed. This pair is the whole argument for consuming the reasoning family -- it is what makes a silent gap explicable rather than indistinguishable from a wedge. The measured gap before any output was 435 seconds.

cases.name: run_finished_with_usage_folded_from_a_real_provider_report
cases.note: The counts are observed: the provider reported input_tokens 18, output_tokens 52, total_tokens 70, and output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens 38 -- 38 of 52 output tokens were reasoning, on a prompt asking for 17 times 23. Kobold's Usage reads none of the nested detail today. Shown here already folded into AG-UI's flat TokenUsage, which is the adapter's job.
